responsibility: Implements associated-item and path-segment probing over Rust types. It represents candidate enum variants, impl items, and trait items; scans enum members, inherent impls, trait impls, explicit bounds, and trait predicates to collect matching items for a segment name; performs Self substitution for trait items; and provides the core candidate sets consumed by path resolution and method lookup.
same_name_distinction: Implements generic associated-item probing over receiver types: it walks enum variants, impl items, associated trait items, and predicate-derived items, including Self substitution and impl-trait-specific searches. Unlike rust-hir-path-probe.h, this file performs the actual candidate discovery and filtering.
